newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT BITE THE BULLET.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT BITE THE BULLET.

text.p: Anderlecht said on Friday that Bosnian libero Suad Katana and Ghanaian international striker Yaw Preko were fit to play in Sunday's Belgian Cup final against Ekeren.

Katana, who suffered a thigh injury earlier this week, was badly needed to shore up Anderlecht's defence against in-form Ekeren, scorers of 21 goals in their last five league games -- all of them victories.

The fitness of Preko, who suffered a calf injury playing for Ghana in a World Cup qualifier against Gabon last month, also sparked a sigh of relief at Anderlecht, whose main striker Gilles De Bilde left in mid-season.
Six other regulars who had been nursing injuries earlier this week, including goalkeeper Geert De Vlieger, were also fit to play, team doctor Raymond Edelman said.
Ekeren's treatment room was also empty on Friday after Bosnian midfielder Cvijan Milosevic and Hungarian defender Ervin Kovacs had resumed normal training, a club official said.
Milosevic had been out for a week with a groin problem and Kovacs was sidelined with a calf injury for three weeks.
Ekeren have only suspended defender Nick Descamps missing.
